title.narrative: Improving Myanmar#s entrepreneurial ecosystem to increase SME development and job creation for youth and women, Phase 1

description.narrative: The Ministry of Industry of Myanmar has expressed a high priority for the project Improving Myanmar#s entrepreneurial ecosystem to increase SME development and job creation for youth and women, Phase 1. It strongly echoes the country#s effort to align to the ASEAN Strategic Action Plan for MSMEs Development (SAPSMED 2016-2025), which created an aligned vision on MSME development and economic convergence for the ASEAN member states. The Government recognizes the unmatched relevance of the technical assistance and expertise that the overall project builds upon. This proposal will build the foundation for a larger project (ID 170024), focusing on more in-depth technical assistance and capacity building, which has already been approved by the Executive Board (13-17 July 2017), and is thus contextually and substantially in line. To ensure effective implementation of allocated funds, the donor has requested the development of a standalone project with a separate budget, work plan and M<(>&<)>E framework. However activities foreseen by this project will support the delivery of technical assistance foreseen in project ID 170024.
